name: keys-bpm-hold
about: D130: letting go of bpm steps the preset only if it was down for fewer than half a second (sample_rate / 2 frames). Stopped at 120 bpm, so a step is 125 ms (R / 8 frames) and nothing fires: the trace is empty. bpm down at 1 and up at 3 (250 ms): a press, 120 steps to 140. Down at 4, up at 9 (625 ms), nothing pressed: a hold, 140 stays. Down at 10, up at 14: exactly half a second at every rate (22050, 24000, 48000 frames), a hold, 140 stays. Down at 15, up at 18 (375 ms): a press, 140 steps to 80, there being no preset above it. Held, slider B shows the tempo: (140 - 60) x 65535 / 180 = 29126. Steps 0 and 3 and write on at 0, as keys-bpm-family, so the free views are its lines.
